description: List the categories (id, name, parent, depth, path such as "Food > Recipes") of a connected WordPress site and, when `search` is given, the tags matching it. Use the ids or exact names in create_post categories / tags; never invent them. Categories are cached for a few minutes on the server. Requires scope ACCOUNTS_READ.

accountId.description: The WordPress site account id (list_accounts, channel WORDPRESS).

search.description: Tag name fragment. Tags are only returned when this is set; categories are always returned.

name: list_wordpress_categories
title: List WordPress categories and tags
